reason: This passage from Numbers 22-24 describes Balak (king of Moab) and his officials attempting to hire the seer Balaam to curse Israel, while Balaam repeatedly blesses Israel instead. The complaints in the text are from Moabite leadership expressing fear of Israel and frustration that Balaam has blessed rather than cursed them. No Hebrew or Israelite leaders appear in this passage, nor do they complain about their own people. The narrative focuses on external opposition to Israel and Balaam's prophetic pronouncements in Israel's favor.
